body:
I took a look at your project and there's a few issues to note:
* [As the docs state](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_parallax2d.html#class-parallax2d-property-follow-viewport), `follow_viewport` is really only meant to be adjusted when you need to place a `Parallax2D` within a separate `CanvasLayer` so that their two viewport follow settings match, so you shouldn't have that turned off in this case. The override section really shouldn't be adjusted unless you have a very specific case.
* You have the example sprites setup incorrectly. [The docs also state ](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/2d/2d_parallax.html#repeat-times)that `repeat_times` are generally only as a shortcut for when your assets are made for a normal zoom, but not zooming out, and you don't want fix them manually. Even though not recommended in cases like this, it will work. However in your case you only set it enough to cover the screen once, not enough to repeat.

If you correct these two problems with your scene, it works as expected:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b018ad22-9154-4122-befe-fc4f86a1340f

[parallax.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24839543/parallax.zip)
